def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']
    k = inputs['k']
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position (1-indexed)
    # We simulate the elimination process
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_pos = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Move k positions forward (counting the current person)
        current_pos = (current_pos + k - 1) % len(people)
        # Remove the person at this position
        people.pop(current_pos)
        # Adjust position if we removed the last element
        if current_pos == len(people):
            current_pos = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
